race.comment: RICH LADY (8) brings the most reliable recent profile, beaten just under 2L in metro company at Morphettville after a solid Balaklava second, and Toeroek going back on is a genuine plus given their record together. ONE KIND (10) is the main danger off a Saturday-company third, where she worked home evenly after interference. WHOOPS A DAISY (9) was beaten a neck as favourite at Gawler after interference at the home turn, with her prior BM64 run and the recent Morphettville line through ONE KIND keeping her right in the winning mix. LISELLE'S LUCK (5) resumes from five months off a Murray Bridge trial, has a win from two starts at this distance, and the 4kg claim gets her in light. Keeping an eye on betting moves.
